preconditions.description: The number of songs minus one (n) is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of queries (q) is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The length of the initial song (s_0) is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of the string t is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k, w in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the index of the song (k) is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(w) > 0 for k, w in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the sailor's name (w) is a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(w) for k, w in queries) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all sailors' names in the queries does not exceed 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s_0 + t + ''.join(w for k, w in queries))
preconditions.description: All characters in s_0, t, and all sailors' names are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of results is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result < 10**9 + 7 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: results[i] == (s_k.count(w) % (10**9 + 7)) for i, (k, w) in enumerate(queries)
postconditions.description: The i-th result is the number of occurrences of the sailor's name w in the k-th song s_k, modulo 10^9 + 7.
